picks.name: Right Tempo / Easy Tempo
picks.source_note: New volume in the ongoing Easy Tempo Experience rework series.
picks.bio: Right Tempo's ongoing series reworking Italian cinematic library and soundtrack heritage (Stelvio Cipriani, G & M De Angelis, Piero Piccioni, and others) through a new generation of producers. "Easy Tempo Experience Vol.3 - BREAK BEAT" (Feb 20, 2026) pushes the series into tighter, heavier, dancefloor-ready territory.
picks.why_listen: Retro soundtrack atmosphere with modern broken-rhythm production -- a great source for library-sampling texture that still works on a floor.

release.title: Easy Tempo Experience Vol.3 - BREAK BEAT

picks.name: Placid Angles
picks.bio: John Beltran's ambient/breakbeat moniker, returning after 20+ albums under his own name. "Canada" (Feb 13, 2026) features Vancouver vocalist Sophia Stel, London producer Tom VR, and Bristolian Yussh -- influence noted by Four Tet, Lone, Skee Mask and Priori.
picks.why_listen: Houses both the depth of ambient and the propulsive force of breakbeats -- each track evoking a distinct part of the Canadian landscape it's named for.

picks.name: Four Tet (as Wingdings)
picks.source_note: Already in your library (Four Tet remix of Bjørn Torske).
picks.bio: Kieran Hebden, already in your library, surprise-released an 8-track album under his Wingdings alias -- literally named/credited using dingbat symbols. Out on his own Text Records: vinyl June 12, digital/Bandcamp July 2, 2026.
picks.why_listen: An internet-breaking surprise drop with deliberately incomprehensible track titles -- worth knowing about even if you never announce whose track it is.
